Oduu fi Gabaasa

Gabaasa walga'ii yuniyeenii, tilmaama haamaa yeroo, misooma kuusaa oomishaa, fi tumsa daldalaa haaraa dubbisaa.

Meki Batu Fruits and Vegetables Growers' Cooperative Union Ltd unites 135 primary cooperatives and 8,089 member farming households across the Central Rift Valley of Oromia, Ethiopia. We specialize in GlobalG.A.P certified fresh horticultural produce, cold-chain handling, and licensed seed production.
